move: blue disc pops in, f draws in two strokes, rings ripple, reaction bubbles float
how: A blue circular badge with an SVG f made of a stem path and a bar path, three ripple ring divs, and two white emoji bubbles (thumbs-up, comment). 0-23%: the badge scales 0->1 with back.out(1.7). At 12% the stem drawSVGs 0->100% (power3.out, 0.6s); at 25% the bar grows from its centre (drawSVG '50% 50%' -> '0% 100%'). At 23% three rings scale 1->2.4 fading out with a 0.2s stagger (power2.out). At 33% and 38% the bubbles pop in from scale 0, y 60 with back.out(2), then bob up 10-14px and back with sine.inOut yoyo. Exit at 82%: bubbles scale to 0 (back.in(2), 0.06s stagger) and the badge collapses to 0 with back.in(1.7).
adapt: Replace the Facebook blue (#1877f2) and the f paths with the product's mark, swap the emoji for its own reaction icons or feature chips, and set the bubble positions. Keep the back.out(1.7) pop, the two-stroke draw order and the 0.2s ring stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the badge SVG, rings and bubbles inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with positions as fractions of D (pop 0, stem 0.12D, bar 0.25D, rings 0.23D, bubbles 0.33D, exit 0.82D). Register DrawSVGPlugin, scope selectors to el, and make the bubble positions relative to el rather than the fixed 1280x720 pixel coordinates.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
bubble positions are absolute pixels for a 1280x720 frame
ends empty; does not return to the first frame
